name: api-catalogue-v0
description: v0 Hello World skeleton for the personal API catalogue platform.

scripts.type-check: npm run sync:openapi && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && ng build --configuration development --no-progress
scripts.test: sh -c 'npm run build:api && node --test apps/api/test/*.test.mjs apps/web/test/*.test.mjs'
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.build:web: npm run sync:openapi && ng build --configuration production --no-progress
